title: ID0414305-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R3 170001516] Plug 1 gets stuck
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Plug 1 gets stuck in step 2 when starting the charging session. The
plug's light is red, the customer had to push “cancel” after which
the plug came back online.
The charging station itself gave no error message.
This happened around 10:10 a.m.
